summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing next-day disclosure returns and a monthly return detailing ongoing share buybacks under Hong Kong listing rules. The filing lists multiple open-market repurchases of ADSs (each representing one Class A ordinary share) at prices ranging from ~$22.12–$22.86 per ADS, totaling 10 tranches between May 20 and June 2, 2026. These buybacks are part of a previously announced capital return program; no board recommendation or advisor is named. The repurchased shares are held as treasury and not yet cancelled. The filing is a routine ongoing disclosure of share repurchases, confirming an active return of capital to shareholders. What to watch: pace of future buybacks and potential cancellation of treasury shares.
